topic: 生活方式与观点支持 · Independent new scenario: a workplace adapting to an energy constraint
grammarFocus: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. All main reading/listening question prompts and options must be English, with short A0/A1 English prompts. Chinese explanations are allowed. Preserve a coherent new scenario; do not rename an earlier text, reuse its facts or reveal answers in question stems.
sourcePolicy: Project-original scenario; simulated figures and people; no copied official test, textbook, GitHub PDF or third-party audio.
title: The Office Energy Challenge
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成10道题目。短文和题目均为英文，解释为中文。本材料为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先通读全文，再做题。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
A. Greenfield Insurance moved to a new office last month. The building is old, and the electricity system is weak. On very cold days, the heaters use a lot of power. If everyone turns on a personal heater, the system may fail. So the company made a new rule: no personal heaters. The manager, Sarah, explained, "We must save energy because the system is old. If we don't save energy, we might lose power." Some workers were unhappy. They said, "We can wear warm clothes, but our hands are still cold." Sarah listened and then said, "You may use a small blanket at your desk. But you might feel cold near the windows." The workers agreed to try. This small change helped, but the company needed more ways to save energy.

B. The company also changed the lights. In the past, all the lights were on all day. Now, workers must turn off the lights in empty rooms. Tom, a worker, said, "I can turn off the lights when I leave a room. But I might forget." Sarah replied, "That's okay. We can put a note on the door." The company also bought new computers. The old computers used more electricity. The new computers use less. However, the new computers are slower. Some workers complained, "We can work faster with the old computers." Sarah said, "I understand. But we must use less energy. You may use the old computers for important jobs." The workers were not happy, but they understood. They knew saving energy was important for the whole company.

C. After one month, the company checked the electricity use. It was 20% lower. Sarah was happy. She said, "We saved energy because we worked together." But some workers still felt cold. One worker, Maria, said, "I wear two sweaters, but my feet are cold." Sarah said, "You can buy warm socks. The company will pay for them." Maria smiled. Another worker, John, said, "I might forget to turn off the lights, but the note helps." The company also started a new rule: on Fridays, workers can work from home. This saves energy because the office is empty. Some workers like this, but others don't. Tom said, "I can work at home, but I miss my friends." Sarah said, "You may come to the office if you want. But we must keep the lights off in empty rooms." Overall, the company saved energy, and most workers were happy with the changes. The experience taught everyone that small actions, like turning off lights and wearing warm clothes, can make a big difference.

questions.prompt: Why did the company make a new rule about heaters?
options: Because the electricity system is weak.
Because the heaters are too expensive.
Because the office is too hot.
Because the workers don't like heaters.
answers: Because the electricity system is weak.
questions.explanation: 原文第一段说“The building is old, and the electricity system is weak.”，因此公司制定规则是因为电力系统弱。
questions.evidence: The building is old, and the electricity system is weak.

questions.prompt: What can workers use at their desks?
questions.explanation: 原文中Sarah说“You may use a small blanket at your desk.”，所以工人可以用小毯子。
questions.evidence: You may use a small blanket at your desk.

questions.prompt: What must workers do in empty rooms?
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“workers must turn off the lights in empty rooms.”，所以工人在空房间必须关灯。
questions.evidence: Now, workers must turn off the lights in empty rooms.

questions.prompt: How much lower was the electricity use after one month?
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“It was 20% lower.”，所以用电量降低了20%。

questions.prompt: What will the company pay for?
questions.explanation: 原文第三段中Sarah说“The company will pay for them.”，这里的them指代前文的warm socks，所以公司会支付暖袜。
questions.evidence: You can buy warm socks. The company will pay for them.

questions.prompt: What is the new rule for Fridays?
options: Workers must stay in the office.
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“on Fridays, workers can work from home.”，所以周五的新规则是可以在家工作。
questions.evidence: on Fridays, workers can work from home.

questions.prompt: Tom misses his friends when he works at home.
questions.explanation: 原文第三段中Tom说“I can work at home, but I miss my friends.”，明确表示他想念朋友，因此该陈述为True。
questions.evidence: I can work at home, but I miss my friends.

questions.prompt: The new computers are faster than the old computers.
questions.explanation: 原文第二段说“the new computers are slower.”，与陈述“新电脑更快”矛盾，因此为False。
questions.evidence: However, the new computers are slower.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: The company also started a new rule: on Fridays, workers can work from ______.
questions.explanation: 原文第三段说“on Fridays, workers can work from home.”，所以填home。
questions.evidence: on Fridays, workers can work from home.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentence with ONE WORD from the passage: Sarah said, "You can buy warm ______."
questions.explanation: 原文第三段中Sarah说“You can buy warm socks.”，所以填socks。

grammar.title: 原因、结果与让步从句；may / might / can 的语气差别
grammar.explanation: 英语中，原因从句常用 because 引导，说明原因；结果从句常用 so 引导，说明结果；让步从句常用 although 引导，表示“虽然……但是……”。注意：because 和 so 不能同时用在同一个句子里；although 和 but 也不能同时使用。情态动词 may、might、can 都可以表示“可能”或“允许”，但语气不同：can 表示能力或较肯定的允许；may 表示允许或可能性，语气较正式；might 表示可能性较小或不确定。例如：You can work at home.（你可以在家工作——允许）You may use a small blanket.（你可以用小毯子——允许，较正式）It might rain later.（稍后可能会下雨——不确定）。
grammar.example: We must save energy because the system is old. If we don't save energy, we might lose power.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: The office is cold, ______ we wear warm clothes.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接结果。
questions.evidence: The office is cold, so we wear warm clothes.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: ______ the new computers are slower, they use less electricity.
questions.explanation: 前后句是让步关系，用 Although 引导让步从句。
questions.evidence: Although the new computers are slower, they use less electricity.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: We turned off the lights ______ we wanted to save energy.
questions.explanation: 后半句是原因，用 because 引导原因从句。
questions.evidence: We turned off the lights because we wanted to save energy.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: I might forget to turn off the lights, ______ I will put a note on the door.
questions.explanation: 前半句是原因，后半句是结果，用 so 连接。
questions.evidence: I might forget to turn off the lights, so I will put a note on the door.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: You ______ use the old computer for important jobs. (permission)
questions.explanation: 表示允许，语气较正式，用 may。
questions.evidence: You may use the old computer for important jobs.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: It ______ rain later, so take an umbrella. (uncertain possibility)
questions.explanation: 表示不确定的可能性，用 might。
questions.evidence: It might rain later, so take an umbrella.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: She ______ speak three languages. (ability)
Choose the correct word: ______ it was cold, they didn't turn on the heater.
questions.explanation: 前后句是让步关系，用 Although 引导。
questions.evidence: Although it was cold, they didn't turn on the heater.

speaking.part2: Describe a time when you had to change your habits to save energy. You should say: what the situation was, what you did, how you felt about it, and whether it was easy or difficult.
part3: Why do some people not want to save energy?
What can companies do to save energy?
Is it important for schools to teach children about saving energy?

transfer.writing: Write a short email (about 100 words) to your manager suggesting one way to save energy in your office. Use because, so, although, and may/might/can.
